lines.zh: 六条腿在我的冠下一起迈
lines.en: Six legs stride beneath my crest.
My short wings lie flat and useless.
My claws grip the rubble firmly.
My crest parts the hanging leaves.

lines.zh: 我用后两足蹬,前四足探
lines.en: Four legs probe, two push.
My body pitches a little as I go.
I climb along the rocky slope.
My short wings flutter once.
My tail tip sweeps the ground.
I turn for the lee side.
Six legs alternate, almost silently.
I dip my head, then raise the crest.
I hold my crest high.

lines.zh: 短翅张了一下又收起来
lines.en: My short wings spread once and fold.

lines.zh: 六条腿分得很开,站得稳
lines.en: My six legs are spread wide for balance.
The wind slides over my crest.
I listen to gravel shifting downhill.
I lower my head and sniff the rock.

lines.zh: 冠上的纹路在光里发亮
lines.en: The ridges of my crest shine.
I part my jaws for a breath.
These wings cannot fly, only glide.
I shift my weight off the front legs.
My hind feet scrape the grit.
The wind on this slope is dry.
I tilt my head, and the crest tilts.

lines.zh: 我站得像块带棱的石头
lines.en: I stand like an angular stone.
My crest is turned toward you.
You stand below, looking up at me.
None of my six legs have moved back.

lines.zh: 短翅动了一下,不是要飞
lines.en: My wings moved, but not to fly.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的冠，脖子会酸。
lines.en: Look up at my crest; your neck will ache.
I lower my head to see your face.
How did you get up here?
My crest is conspicuous, is it not?
I slowly turn my body aside.
We two are alone on this slope.
These short wings don't lift me high.
I make a low sound in my throat.
My crest has been knocked askew.
I back up the slope to steady.

lines.zh: 六条腿有一对着不上力
lines.en: One pair of my legs will not take weight.
One wing membrane has torn.

lines.zh: 冠饰被撞歪，我闷声发火。
lines.en: My crest is knocked askew; I growl low.
This body is not so sturdy.

lines.zh: 断翅垂着，我换了条腿撑住。
lines.en: My broken wing hangs; I brace on another leg.
Grit is lodged in the wound.
I can still hold my ground.
I will not retreat downhill.
That smell drifts up from below.
I take one step forward.
All six legs want to move at once.

lines.zh: 短翅张开，我朝味道探过头。
lines.en: My short wings spread; I crane toward the smell.
This smells edible.
Stay still for now.
My wings twitch without my leave.
A little closer.
My crest has risen higher.
I am not picky, but I like it fresh.
You struck my foreleg.

lines.zh: 我退了一步,六足重新站稳
lines.en: I step back and my six feet re-set.
My crest grazed you.
The impact turned me aside.
I brace with my hind legs.
You are much lighter than me.
Stones roll down from under my feet.
Do not stand between my legs.
I shake my short wings.
I speak only once six legs are set.
I tilt my crest toward you.
Our six-legged stances fall in line.
I spread my short wings for you.
The wind is strong; come closer.
I lower my head to your height.
We hold this slope.
Crest touches crest.
You need not fear my teeth.
Rest here a while.
We go once the wind drops.
I pin it with a foreclaw.
This smells strange.
I pick it up and test it.
Too hard; I cannot bite it.
I toss it down the slope.
I tuck it beside my cheek.
This cannot be eaten at all.
I will hold on to it for now.
I step on it and it breaks.
This is somewhat interesting.
I have kept my eye on you.
My crest has come down.
My six legs take their places.
You stand downhill; retreat will be hard.
I have read your stance through.
Stones will roll on this slope.
I lower my forequarters further.
I have spread my wings.
I accept this fight.
You still have a chance to leave.
Do I move first, or you?
Gravel is sliding under my feet.
I have your position.
This whole slope is mine.
I turn as your direction changes.
Six legs carry me closer, little by little.
You go left; I take the high side.

lines.zh: 坡上的石头在我脚下滚
lines.en: Stones roll from under me.

lines.zh: 我短翅张着,不是为了飞
lines.en: My wings are spread, but not to fly.
I wait for a foothold.
Your steps are losing rhythm.
I come down from the upper flank.
My crest never leaves you.
I am slow, but I do not stop.
You have backed to the steep edge.
Two more breaths.
This distance is enough.
I fold my short wings away.
This angle is best.
My foreclaw comes down.
My crest strikes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我这副短翅，压下来像块板。
lines.en: These short wings come down like a plank.
My teeth catch the cloth armor.
All six legs drive at once.
You are shoved down the slope.
My short wings spread for balance.
I whip my head and take you down.
Gravel rolls with us.
I pull back two steps.
The crest landed first.
You are still standing; good.
I drop low and come again.
The slope has gone quiet.
My crest crests the hill first.
My six feet settle one by one.
My short wings shake off the dust.
I step out from behind the rocks.
My crest throws a long shadow.
Stones fall away under me.
I raise my head and look around.
The wind whistles over my crest.
I have paused here a long while.
There is flat ground in the lee.
I head for it.

lines.zh: 六足的印子留在岩面上
lines.en: Six-toed prints remain on the rock.
My throat-call echoes on the slope.
You should look up.
I have arrived here.
One more crest-shadow on this slope.
A hole is burned through my wing.

lines.zh: 陡坡上没抓稳，摔进灌木。
lines.en: I lost my footing and tumbled into the shrubs.
Water fills the ridges of my crest.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀得翻了个身
lines.en: The blast rolls me over.
The arrow is in my shoulder; I cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的冠里
lines.en: That force burrows into my crest.
Hunger makes all six legs weak.
Lightning strikes my crest ridge.

lines.zh: 六条腿都找不到着力点
lines.en: None of my six legs find purchase.
